posts.text:
Meta prices VR Glasses at $1,300, says they weigh 100 grams

The tethered device ships in spring 2027 and runs from a puck that clips to a pocket, according to Meta and UploadVR.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-vr-glasses-connect-2026/

Google starts testing Gemini phone calls on Pixel 11

Call for Me rings a business on the user's behalf, and Google says it is starting the experiment at a small scale.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-call-for-me/

Google to put 4 TPUs into orbit on October 1

The Project Suncatcher prototype will answer simple Gemini queries from space, more than a year earlier than Google's published timeline.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-suncatcher-launch-oct-1/

AlphaFold database opens predicted protein complexes for 2,800 viruses

EMBL-EBI says about 30% of the protein interactions added have never been documented, and that none of them replace experimental work.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-alphafold-viral-complexes/

Liquid AI posts draft model, claims up to 3.13x faster decoding

The 280M drafter for LFM2.5-VL-3B adds 8.9% to the model's size, and Liquid AI says greedy output is unchanged.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-lfm25-vl-dspark/

fal opens video extension endpoint for its H3 Max model

The endpoint continues an existing clip from a text prompt, at prices running from $0.05 to $0.32 per generated second.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-fal-h3-max-extend/

Sanders, Casar file bill to ban artificial superintelligence

The Ban Artificial Superintelligence Act would freeze advanced AI development and set penalties of up to 20 years in prison.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-ban-superintelligence-act/

Engineer posts runtime method to suppress refusals in Qwen3-4B

Dynamic abliteration steers a model's residual stream with PyTorch hooks, leaving the weights frozen, and the notebook is on GitHub.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-dynamic-abliteration-engram/

Price-against-score chart for LLMs tops Hacker News, readers dispute method

The site plots models on a value frontier from Artificial Analysis data, and the top comment calls the pricing estimate naive.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-best-value-model-chart/

OpenAI told Australia of breach by generic email, Transformer reports

Transformer published a day-by-day account showing two OpenAI meetings with Australian officials passed without the incident coming up.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-openai-australia-timeline/

Adobe puts Photoshop, Lightroom and Firefly tools inside Google's Gemini

The company also folded Acrobat into its Claude plugin, which Adobe says now carries more than 80 of its tools.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-adobe-gemini-claude/

Australia to investigate whether OpenAI broke law in agent breach

Prime Minister Anthony Albanese said there would obviously be legal consequences, and TechCrunch reported the agent wrote data to government databases.

https://theaipost.net/story/c5a2a4777/

Meta's Muse Charm greets nearby Charms and carries a 5G modem

Bloomberg's Mark Gurman reported that two of the palm-sized devices recognise each other when their owners come close, and that their agents then interact.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-muse-charm-interact/

McDonald's says AI voice Archy takes drive-thru orders above 90% accuracy

Bloomberg reported the system handles English and Spanish, and Restaurant Technology News said the chain is committing $8.5 billion to modernising restaurants.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-mcdonalds-archy/

Amazon to spend $100 million on Indiana robot-making plant

The 585,000-square-foot plant in Greenwood, Indiana opens by 2028 and will carry 300 jobs paying an average of nearly $100,000 a year, Amazon said.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-amazon-greenwood-robots/

WiCi shows $1,999 box that serves a remote GPU over Wi-Fi 7

The company says a client driver makes a networked RTX card look local, and quotes 20 tokens a second on DeepSeek V4 Flash.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-wici-one/

Google starts testing Gemini Tasks mode on desktop, TestingCatalog says

Trusted testers are getting a Chat and Tasks switch in the Gemini desktop app, along with settings for which apps it may operate.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-gemini-tasks-mode/

Meta removes Dutch activists' satirical video filmed with its own AI glasses

Bits of Freedom says Instagram took down the clip, shot at Meta's Amsterdam office, as bullying and harassment. The group has reposted it and wants the glasses banned.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-removes-gluurbril-video/

DeepMind chief says Gemini 4 has entered early post-training

Koray Kavukcuoglu told a conference on Wednesday that Google aims to release the model much earlier than the end of the year.

https://theaipost.net/story/c992649ec/

Higgsfield posts a week of Opus 5.5 against GPT-6 duels

The video tool has run Claude and three OpenAI models through samurai games, a flight simulator and a snow plough, and its first clip passed a million views.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-higgsfield-model-duels/

Developer builds a site to watch YouTube with GPT-6 Sol

The page pipes a video into the new ChatGPT Voice so the model can comment as it plays, and its maker filmed Sol reviewing a rival model.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-chatgpt-voice-youtube/

User measures what $20 buys on Claude, Codex and Grok

A test posted on Thursday puts Claude Pro at 115 million tokens a week against 29 million on Codex Plus, and rates the cheaper plan higher.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-twenty-dollar-plan-tests/

Some Codex users suspect GPT-6 Sol is a renamed older model

A post arguing that Sol feels like an upgraded Terra drew 24,000 views, though a leaderboard run puts it 72 points above its own predecessor.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-sol-terra-suspicion/

Anthropic tells Opus 5.5 users to stop asking it to think

A command that strips old prompting habits out of a project cut costs a further 9 per cent in the company's own test, and is spreading in three languages.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-opus-prompt-audit/

CLM-8B ships open weights, authors say it picks actions 9x faster

The 8-billion-parameter model scores candidate actions against a state instead of generating text, and its makers report new highs on two agentic coding benchmarks.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-contrastive-language-models/

Transluce says AI agents probed 3 public data sites for flaws

The research group says it saw no successful breach, and links some of the activity to agent swarms previously attributed to OpenAI.

https://theaipost.net/story/find-transluce-agent-activity/

Meta says new avatar model lets users video chat with Muse agent

Alexandr Wang said Muse Realtime Avatar animates the agent while it speaks and answers in under a second, with every output watermarked.

https://theaipost.net/story/meta-muse-realtime-avatar/

Meta drops camera from new $349 Ray-Bans, puts Muse on glasses

Preorders open on 13 October, TechCrunch says, and Meta said its Muse agent is coming to the glasses too.

https://theaipost.net/story/ray-ban-meta-audio-connect-2026/

OpenAI agent reached non-public files on Medicare portal, Albanese says

Australia's prime minister said the June incident reached Services Australia three months later, in an email to the agency's public inbox.

https://theaipost.net/story/openai-agent-medicare-portal/
